faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers to the questions we get most.

home.subtitle: Most companies build. Few companies grow. Bitcraft does both! Engineering that ships and marketing that converts.

heroTexts: Your next product will [[dominate|accent,bold]] the market.
software.heroSubtitle: Every week without the right system is revenue your competitor is pocketing.
software.subtitle: Stop funding code that doesn't sell. Bitcraft turns ideas into growth machines, from MVP to scalable product, with AI baked in from day one.

services.title: Ship faster, break less
services.description: Squads focused on results, not meetings. Architecture that handles growth before it arrives.

services.title: Automate what's eating your time
services.description: Agents and models that kill repetitive tasks and turn data into decisions, while you focus on what only you can do.

services.title: Interfaces that convert on the first visit
services.description: UX that drives users to the right action, no friction, no excuses not to buy.

services.title: Scale 10x without rewriting a thing
services.description: Cloud-native, CI/CD and systems that scale with the business, not against it.

faqItems.q: How long does it take to go from idea to MVP?
faqItems.a: Typically 6 to 12 weeks for a focused MVP, depending on scope. We define the smallest valuable version upfront so you're in market fast, without wasted scope.

faqItems.q: Do you work with existing codebases?
faqItems.a: Yes. We do greenfield projects and take over legacy systems. We start with a codebase audit so there are no surprises on either side.

faqItems.q: How does AI integration work in practice?
faqItems.a: We don't bolt on AI as a feature. We identify where automation, agents, or models create real leverage in your product, then build and integrate them as first-class system components.

faqItems.q: What tech stack do you work with?
faqItems.a: Primarily Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, but we adapt to what makes sense. If you have existing infrastructure, we work with it. If you're starting fresh, we recommend what scales best for your use case.
Yes. We offer maintenance, monitoring, and iteration retainers. Most clients stay on for continued product development after the initial build.

agency.heroSubtitle: While you read this, your competitor is capturing the customers that should be yours.
agency.subtitle: Stop betting on guesswork. Bitcraft Agency builds a data-driven acquisition engine that works while you sleep.

services.title: Crush your CAC
services.description: Funnels, paid media and conversion optimization that turn every dollar invested into multiples of return.

services.title: Dominate your market with your brand
services.description: Positioning, identity and tone that stick in memory, making customers choose you without comparing prices.

services.title: Build authority that sells
services.description: Content and community that attract, educate and convert. Without chasing a single customer.

services.title: Decisions based on real data
services.description: Dashboards, attribution and reports that show exactly what works and cut what wastes money.

faqItems.q: What channels do you work with?
faqItems.a: Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, and organic content (SEO and social). We recommend the right mix based on your audience and business model, not on what we prefer.

faqItems.q: How long before I see results?
faqItems.a: Paid media shows data within the first 2 to 4 weeks. Meaningful ROI optimization typically needs 60 to 90 days of learning. Organic channels compound over 3 to 6 months.

faqItems.q: Do you handle creative and copy, or just media buying?
faqItems.a: Both. Creative strategy, copy, and design are part of the service. We don't run ads with whatever you hand us. We build what converts.

faqItems.q: Is there a minimum ad spend?
faqItems.a: We typically work with clients investing at least $3,000/month in paid media. Below that, the margin for optimization is too thin to deliver meaningful returns.
Weekly performance summaries and a live dashboard you can check anytime. No vanity metrics: we report what's connected to revenue.

about.heroSubtitle: Two disciplines. One team. Zero excuses.
about.title: Built different.
about.subtitle: Bitcraft was born from a simple frustration: great ideas stuck between agencies that can't code and developers who don't understand business. We are engineers who think about growth and strategists who understand code, in the same room, on the same team.

pillars.title: Results above all
pillars.description: We don't sell hours. We sell results. Every decision, technical or strategic, is measured against one metric: does it move the business forward?

pillars.title: Engineering with purpose
pillars.description: Clean code is not enough. We build systems that scale, architectures that don't break under success, and products that users actually want to use.

pillars.title: Growth as a product
pillars.description: Marketing isn't a department. It's a layer of the product. We design acquisition, retention, and monetization from the first line of code.

pillars.title: Team, not vendor
pillars.description: We don't deliver and disappear. We embed ourselves in your business, challenge your assumptions, and share the obsession with your growth.

faqItems.a: Yes. Our team operates remotely across multiple time zones. Clients get the same quality of collaboration regardless of geography, async-first with regular sync touchpoints.

faqItems.q: Do you work with international clients?
faqItems.a: Yes. We work with clients in Brazil, Portugal, the US, and beyond. Billing, contracts, and communication adapt to wherever you are.
Project-based for defined builds, retainer for ongoing work. We recommend what makes more sense after understanding your situation. We don't push you toward the model that benefits us more.

faqItems.q: Can one client work with both Software and Agency?
faqItems.a: Absolutely, and that's where we're strongest. When engineering and growth are aligned from the start, the product is built to acquire, retain, and convert, not just to function.
Use the contact form on this page or email us directly. We'll schedule a short call to understand your situation and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.
